description:
Assemble a technical manual for the 'Hydra-X Hydraulic Power Unit' using LibreOffice Writer's Master Document feature. 

1. Create a new Master Document (File > New > Master Document).
2. The source chapters are located in '/home/ga/Documents/Hydra_Manual/':
   - '01_safety.odt'
   - '02_operation.odt'
   - '03_maintenance.odt'
3. Insert these three files into the Master Document as LINKS (do not just copy-paste the text). They must be in the correct order (01, then 02, then 03).
4. Insert a Table of Contents at the beginning of the Master Document.
5. Save the Master Document as 'hydra_manual_master.odm' inside the '/home/ga/Documents/Hydra_Manual/' directory.
